deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: Whether the code table file was removed.

previous_revision.title: Previous Revision
previous_revision.description: The revision of the file before it was deleted.

400.description: The node is not a Data Map node (not_a_data_map).

404.description: Node not found, or no code table with that id (no_table).

409.description: A rule or the node's Lua uses the table (in_use), the file changed (stale), or the node follows a catalog (catalog_linked).
